Astra confirmed and fixed the replay defect on current main.

- All four add-on webhook paths reproduced erroneous **409** responses after business commit but before receipt finalization.
- Five regression cases now return **200**, preserve a single financial/add-on outcome, and deduplicate subsequent delivery.
- Tenant/account binding, payment authority, and receipt fencing remain intact.
- Passed **392 PostgreSQL, 2,733 server, and 1,725 app tests**, plus TypeScript, formatting and Knope. Lint has three existing warnings.

Local review commit: `6f8900156d6` on `codex/evo-61-addon-webhook-replay`. Nothing pushed, merged, or deployed; publication gates and Copilot review remain pending.

Updated [EVO-61](https://linear.app/evorto/issue/EVO-61), [Trail 38](https://entire.com/gh/evorto-app/-/trails/38), and ASTRA-002. Live data remained untouched.
The other investigation has released its shared runtime reservations. EVO-61 remains ready for local review; its code and publication status are unchanged.
